title: Water Barrel

sources.title: Water Barrel
markers: | description = Water Barrel is a common [[Consumables|Consumable]] that can be used to remove or create certain environmental hazards

summary: Break or throw the barrel to spill Water in a 20 ft radius.

fields.Use: Damage the barrel to spill Water in a 20 ft radius or use an Action to Throw and break it. Range depends on Strength and weight.
fields.Water: Water douses exposed flames. Lightning can electrify it and Cold can freeze it. Fire can make a Steam Cloud.
fields.Acquisition: Found in locations including Waukeen’s Rest.
fields.Base value: 5 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
